page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8163 processor, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-hypervised server features 32 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, delivering a total of 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no local storage and has no bundled GPUs, relying on a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core performance is weak, as demonstrated by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression in the bottom 10 percent. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores consistently placing in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register in the average tier, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this instance is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as static web serving, database operations, and software compilation, which all achieved average tier benchmark results. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or memory-intensive operations where single-core bottlenecks or lower memory efficiency may limit throughput. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation offers predictable multi-core performance, but the trade-off lies in the lower single-core resource density relative to newer processor generations.
